_about: Public-domain W. E. Blackstone (William Eugene Blackstone, 1841-1935, Methodist layman, premillennial writer) for the Word Hoard, held to printings dated before 1930: Jesus Is Coming (revised edition, copyright 1898, and the enlarged presentation edition, copyright 1908) and Our God and His Universe (Shanghai, 1911), all signed 'W. E. B.' on the title page. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

blackstone-jesus-coming-1898: Jesus Is Coming, revised edition, signed W. E. B. (Chicago and New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1898)
blackstone-jesus-coming-1908: Jesus Is Coming, presentation edition, enlarged, signed W. E. B. (Chicago and New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1908)
blackstone-our-god-universe: Our God and His Universe, signed W. E. B. (Shanghai: American Presbyterian Mission Press, 1911)

_alternates.blackstone-1916-printing: Jesus Is Coming, 1908 text with the 1916-17 Moody letters and his full name on the title page (jesusiscoming00blac_3) and other copies
_alternates.blackstone-undated: Jesus Is Coming, undated Revell second edition (jesusiscoming00blac_0) and London Partridge issue (jesusiscomingrs00blacuoft)
